text: {"purpose":"Processes a daily transaction file, validates each record against cross‑reference and account data, posts valid transactions to a transaction file, updates account and category balances, and records rejected transactions.","inputs":["DALYTRAN-FILE","XREF-FILE","ACCOUNT-FILE","TCATBAL-FILE"],"outputs":["TRANSACT-FILE","DALYREJS-FILE"],"side_effects":["Updates account balances in ACCOUNT-FILE","Updates transaction category balances in TCATBAL-FILE","Writes transaction records to TRANSACT-FILE","Writes rejected records to DALYREJS-FILE"],"role":"batch","error_handling":"Uses APPL-RESULT and IO-STATUS to detect file errors, displays messages, and calls external ABEND routine CEE3ABD on fatal errors.","evidence":[{"line_start":202,"line_end":219,"claim":"Main loop reads daily file and processes each transaction."},{"line_start":345,"line_end":369,"claim":"Reads next record from DALYTRAN-FILE and sets EOF flag."},{"line_start":2000,"line_end":2500,"claim":"Posts transaction, updates balances, writes transaction or reject record."}]}
